title: Federal community-development formula grants to San Francisco, FY2022-FY2026
question: How much did San Francisco receive each year from HUD’s four formula grants, and is it moving?
finding: Formula allocations went from $32,410,885 in FY2022 to $32,078,940 in FY2026; Emergency Solutions Grants (homeless shelter money) from $1,587,675 to $1,652,189. Nothing unusual: these follow a national formula.
how: San Francisco, CA rows of HUD's all-grantee formula allocation workbooks for FY2022 to FY2025 (this batch) and FY2026 (already on disk).
limits: Allocations are set by formula, not by performance, and are spent over several years. Workbooks before FY2022 returned not-found when requested.

sources.t: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, community planning and development formula allocations, all grantees, FY2022-FY2025
